description: Use when you need a weather forecast, the current weather, temperature, rain or wind for the next hours or days at given coordinates. Do not use for historical weather, severe weather alerts or places given only by name (geocode first). Returns JSON with the weather forecast for a latitude and longitude: hourly temperature, rain and precipitation, wind, humidity and cloud cover for the next days, from MET Norway for 0.003 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.003 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

hours.description: How many hours ahead to return (1-240, 48 when omitted); hourly at first, then every 6 hours

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), e.g. 59.9139 for Oslo, rounded to 4 decimals

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), e.g. 10.7522 for Oslo, rounded to 4 decimals

name: blackwood_weather_forecast
title: Weather forecast
